note: v2.0 enforces strict full-mask final-dot independence (R6b_full_mask_independence) in addition to surface/novel-dot independence (R6a_lane_independence), eliminating the v1.1 carrier exemption after PR #11 logged historical H82-2 (37091 dots, overlap 0.9611) as a final-dot duplicate.

amendments.A1_R2_measurement: v1.0 compared candidate quadrants against HAND-COPIED base quadrant values that came from the WRONG instrument (v1 SGMC-RAW instead of SGMC-FAR). v1.1+ evaluates the base mask IN-PROCESS with the same evaluator. Rule unchanged (>=3/4 quadrants non-negative). Root cause + proof: evidence/r2_fix_note.md.
amendments.A2_R6_strict_full_mask: Rule 1 of the parallel-run brief requires rank-correlation <= 0.90 and 3-px dot overlap <= 0.70 vs every registry raster on BOTH the discovery surface before placement (R6a) AND the final dots (R6b). Historical H82-2 (37091 dots) failed R6b (overlap 0.9611, rho 0.9522 vs H33-2-B2) and was archived as a duplicate negative deliverable (PR #11). Lane H82-3 passes both R6a and R6b against all 6 registry rasters (D2.8, R1-SOLO, H33-2-B2, H36-rung30, H19-5, and historical H82-2) with zero carrier exemption.

promotion_rules.R1_primary_win: SGMC-FAR pooled DTI margin vs base >= +0.0005
promotion_rules.R2_quadrant_consistency: SGMC-FAR per-quadrant DTI non-negative margin in >= 3 of 4 quadrants (base evaluated in-process)
promotion_rules.R3_no_loss_mid: SGMC-MID pooled DTI margin vs base >= -0.001
promotion_rules.R4_no_loss_raw: SGMC-RAW pooled DTI margin vs base >= -0.001
promotion_rules.R5_live_safety: net dot count <= base AND positive net TP gain vs base across SGMC-FAR/MID/RAW, with added-dot SGMC-FAR credit/dot >= 0.111 (2x live bar under 50% transfer)
promotion_rules.R6a_lane_independence: discovery-surface rank-rho <= 0.90 vs EVERY registry raster AND novel added-dots 3px-overlap <= 0.70 vs EVERY registry raster
promotion_rules.R6b_full_mask_independence: FULL FINAL-DOT MASK Spearman rank-rho <= 0.90 AND 3px-overlap <= 0.70 vs EVERY registry raster (including H33-2-B2 and historical H82-2; no carrier exemption)
promotion_rules.R7_audit: 12/12 submission checks PASS on BOTH -zeros.tif and -nan.tif variants
